name: Fredis Beleris - Après le § 8 - Am 8
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2024
part_text: 8a. Strongly criticises the way the Committee on Petitions handled a petition, filed on behalf of Plataforma Ulloa Viva, denouncing the serious detrimental environmental consequences related to a project to construct a cellulose processing facility in Galicia; strongly regrets the breach of the procedural rules, which led to this petition being closed, although the petitioners, supported by various associations and local authorities, submitted very detailed legal and scientific analyses proving that this project fails to meet the criteria set out in Regulation (EU) 2021/241, establishing the Recovery and Resilience Facility1a, and entails a very high level of natural resource consumption, massive pollution, the destruction of an area of exceptional value for biodiversity, and the degradation of key ecosystem services, which are crucial for climate change mitigation; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a OJ L 57, 18.2.2021, p. 17, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/241/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2021/241/oj).
